metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1951 · A Christmas Carol
metas.description: Ebenezer Scrooge, a curmudgeonly, miserly businessman, has no time for sentimentality and largely views Christmas as a waste of time. However, this Christmas Eve, he will be visited by three spirits who will show him the error of ...

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1956 · The Ten Commandments
metas.description: Moses, raised as a prince of Egypt in the Pharaoh's household, learns of his true heritage as a Hebrew and his divine mission as the deliverer of his people from slavery.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1950 · Cinderella
metas.description: When Cinderella's cruel stepmother prevents her from attending the Royal Ball, she gets some unexpected help from the lovable mice Gus and Jaq and from her Fairy Godmother.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1959 · Sleeping Beauty
metas.description: After being snubbed by the royal family, a malevolent fairy places a curse on a princess which only a prince can break, along with the help of three good fairies.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1953 · Peter Pan
metas.description: Wendy and her brothers are whisked away to the magical world of Neverland with the hero of their stories, Peter Pan.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1954 · 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
metas.description: A ship sent to investigate a wave of mysterious sinkings encounters the advanced submarine, the Nautilus, commanded by Captain Nemo.
